title: Trends and Developments in Modern Applications of Polyaniline
bookshelves: Category: Technology, Engineering, Agriculture, Industrial processes
summary: Intrinsically conducting polymers and their syntheses, properties, and applications have been studied for a long time. Among them, polyaniline is a conducting polymer with incredible promise, being one of the most investigated and useful conjugated polymers with a dynamic range of applications. This book explores some intriguing aspects of polyaniline, including methods of synthesis, properties, and applications, as well as some remaining challenges in developing applications using polyaniline.
